name: universe_read_contracts
description: Read plain pinned, visible action roles/requirements/consequences and authored knowledge/channel contracts and named exhaustive object collections, relationship roles, authored cross-occurrence maxima and visible author-perspective relationship assertions. Restricted perspectives omit occurrence values. Objective and observer-known sets remain distinct; absent declarations are open/unknown. Exact action names; empty discovers names. No missing contract implies a default rule. No internal record joins required.

action_names.description: Exact action names. Empty returns visible action names plus relevant knowledge/channel contracts.

name: universe_read_facts
description: Read plain effective facts for named objects in a pinned context. Optional world selects an exact authored world; omission never infers one. Returns exact authored property names and plain values, support/refutation/conflicts/unknowns, scope, time and actual coverage. Inherited attributes are returned separately from instance facts and initial-value candidates, with named classification/ancestry. Reusable definitions can also be researched by name. Missing or ambiguous identities never imply a new identity. Reuse returned property names for deltas. Source records are resolved by the engine; no internal schemas or ID joins required.

world.description: Explicit authored world name; absence does not select or infer a world.

object_names.description: Exact instance or reusable definition names to research. A missing or ambiguous match remains explicit.

name: universe_check_changes
description: Check plain factual deltas from author writing against pinned canon. An explicitly selected authorized author perspective is required; other perspectives are research only. Resolve existing objects by their exact visible names; introduce new identities only explicitly. Preserve dialogue, beliefs, plans, hypothetical and figurative claims as non-objective. The engine constructs canonical records, creates a provisional candidate, validates it and inspects impact. It returns a candidate handle, findings and material clarifications; it never approves or publishes. Scope/time/ownership ambiguities remain unresolved. Authored at_date/sent_date/received_date/end_date alternatives use only the selected context’s authored calendar; until lifetimes accept end_date. Gregorian dates require explicit-offset RFC3339 whole seconds, fictional calendars retain exact authored coordinates. Raw ticks remain supported; supplied date and tick must agree. Dates never infer current time, relative tomorrow, time zones, conversions or integer delays. Named narrative_works and work_editions explicitly establish works/editions; publish each before linking it. story_contexts kind narrator requires an existing narrator entity, parent, calendar and narration story_time. scenes selects a published work/edition, narration_context and explicit depicted_events handles; optional reader_order is not event time and no disclosure is inferred. Private contract review is required for contexts, editions and scenes. Named definitions introduce reusable types/parent relationships/shared attributes; classification introduces or refines an instance without replacing identity. Shared attributes never become initial stock. definitions.initial_values declare starting candidates, which must be approved before explicit initializations select their opaque handles. Each initialization requires an explicit occurred start using a declared action/participants/time/world, or a retrieved pinned occurred-event handle, and an authored interval. First mention, classification and restart never initialize or refill. event_corrections use pinned occurred-event handles and changed named fields; omitted fields retain canon. Participants explicitly replace all bindings; empty requires_knowledge explicitly clears direct Knows preconditions. Effects are recalculated from authored contracts, never editable stock facts. Manual effects outside declared slots require advanced correction. Later events are checked but never automatically rewritten. event_withdrawals use the current returned event_edit_handle and author reason to withdraw support for an incorrectly recorded occurrence; generated effects are removed and past revisions remain. This never asserts non-occurrence or opposite facts. Surviving dependencies can block withdrawal; exact private factual source review and author approval remain required. New scalar properties impose no single-value constraint; explicit properties declare type, multiplicity and persistence without revising existing definitions. property_corrections change only explicitly supplied single_value/persistence on a named existing property, with a reason. Omitted metadata, value types and units remain unchanged; private contract review is required. Old assertions retain authored validity/persistence; new facts follow the revised default. definition_corrections revise named type ancestry/applicability without reclassifying instances; an explicit root parent removes ancestry. action_corrections replace only supplied requirements/effects/applicability or explicit tick plus lifetime; omitted fields retain canon. Both require private contract review, preserve history and recheck affected instances/events. Supplied action lists replace the complete selected field; custom legacy effect slots require advanced editing. Factual corrections, including shared attributes, use returned opaque authored assertion-version handles. Retrieve a new handle after correction; a fresh context cannot retarget a stale handle. Generated event facts cannot be edited directly. fact_endings use a current fact_handle, explicit end_tick on its authored interval calendar and reason; past support remains. fact_withdrawals use current fact_handle and reason to remove support without asserting the opposite. Only one correction, ending or withdrawal per fact per delta; dependent actions are rechecked, never repaired automatically. item_powers declare abilities from an explicitly authored single-valued object holder property on a named item, plus ability_property/value/scope/at_tick/lifetime. Ownership relations do not establish possession. Private contract review is required; read_contracts returns declarations and read_facts returns actual derived abilities while holder evidence and grant both apply. item_power_corrections use the returned version-bound grant_handle and reason to change only value/scope/authored validity or explicitly shorten its interval; item, holder and ability targets remain unchanged. Corrections and endings require private contract review. Named actions support role/property/value requirements, set or bounded exact integer/decimal-delta effects and authored lifetimes. Constraints support resource_accounting or no_opposing_evidence. Explicit exhaustive_sets declare all named members of an object-valued property for authored subject/scope/time/lifetime; required members=[] deliberately declares none. Absence never implies completeness. Exhaustive declarations require private contract review; member facts are checked against applicable objective boundaries. relation_definitions explicitly introduce named unordered, unrestricted-type roles with single/multiple local multiplicity. relation_limits declare actual subject-or-role grouping, counted role and maximum in authored scope/time; limits require private contract review and always block violations. relationships submit objective subject/participant names using existing roles; type restrictions and ordering remain authored, missing names/undeclared roles require clarification. relationship_corrections use returned opaque authored assertion-version handles, changed participant roles and a reason; each supplied role list replaces that role ([] clears), omitted roles and subject/relation/scope/time remain unchanged. relationship_endings explicitly end an authored interval at an exclusive end_tick on its original calendar, with a reason. Atomic ending plus a new occurrence supports transfers; overlapping ownership still conflicts. Stale or generated handles cannot edit. Corrections/endings require exact private factual source review. No limit implies exclusivity, no minimum is inferred, and ordinary scoped waivers are unsupported. knowledge_boundaries explicitly prohibit one holder knowing one exact claim in the selected represented context, explicit universe/named world scope and finite authored interval. They require private contract review and always block overlapping Knows, including explicit author-established knowledge. Missing attitudes remain unknown, beliefs and dialogue stay separate, and no claim truth is established. read_contracts returns version-bound policy_handle; policy_corrections may explicitly revise scope/interval or end it with supplied start/lifetime, preserving holder/claim/context. There is no approval waiver or automatic ending on receipt. knowledge_policies explicitly declare author_established or justified mode on the selected context, or named channel forward/delay timing; no delivery or understanding is inferred. Contracts require separate private author declaration review and exact approval. Author-established knows remains held until the separate private establish_knowledge decision selecting holder/claim/time/lifetime/rationale and exact author approval; neither source review nor generic approval creates the decision. Explicit quantities use {amount,unit} with exact authored numbers and named units. Quantity properties require a unit. Visible unit metadata is returned by read_contracts; explicit no-conversion unit declarations require private contract review. Never infer dimension, symbol, unit conversion or physics. Quantity deltas require exact integer/decimal amounts and bounds with the declared unit. Unsupported precision or overflow is rejected, never rounded; no unit conversion is inferred. Existing authored property semantics and resource accounting remain enforced.

context_id.description: Opaque context handle returned by research. The engine pins author admission to the same revision.

worlds.description: Explicit named worlds. Introduce only with author intent; existing visible names reuse their identity. No default world, location or entity association is inferred.

story_contexts.description: Explicit dreams, accounts or embedded stories. Publish then open by name before adding local facts; parent structure never copies facts.

narrative_works.description: Explicit named narrative works; publish before declaring an edition.

work_editions.description: Explicit editions of existing works; current binds the exact researched revision, unbound selects none.

scenes.description: Explicit scenes of an existing edition. Reader order, narration context and depicted events are independent; depiction does not disclose.

scene_corrections.description: Version-bound scene corrections; omitted fields remain authored, supplied lists replace explicitly. Edition and scene identity cannot change.

changes.description: Only factual deltas; do not restate the universe or unchanged facts.

aliases.description: Explicit contextual names for existing identities, not new objects or inferred knowledge. One new alias per entity per delta.

definitions.description: Explicit reusable definitions, subtype introductions and shared attributes. Independent stock belongs in changes, not here.

properties.description: Explicit property declarations; never inferred single-value resources. Existing definitions cannot be silently changed.

property_corrections.description: Explicit multiplicity/persistence corrections to existing named properties; omitted fields retain authored settings. Private contract review required; types and units cannot change.

units.description: Explicit unit declarations without inferred conversion/scale; private contract review required.

item_powers.description: Explicit possession-dependent abilities; private contract review required. Possession is the named single-valued object holder property on this item, never inferred from an ownership relation.

item_power_corrections.description: Version-bound grant corrections/endings. Omitted fields retain authored values; targets cannot change. Private contract review required.

definition_corrections.description: Incremental ancestry/applicability revisions; omitted fields keep authored metadata. Requires private contract review.

action_corrections.description: Incremental supported action revisions; supplied lists explicitly replace those fields, omitted fields stay unchanged. Requires private contract review.

constraints.description: Finite supported policies. Separate private author contract review is required before publication.

exhaustive_sets.description: Explicit objective exhaustive object collections. Absence of a declaration stays open/unknown; private contract review required.

relation_definitions.description: Explicit finite named relation contracts; requires private contract review.

relation_limits.description: Authored cross-occurrence maxima, separate from local role multiplicity; private contract review required.

relation_corrections.description: Incremental edits to existing role metadata; omitted roles/fields stay unchanged. Private contract review required.

relation_limit_corrections.description: Incremental existing maximum/grouping/scope/time edits; omitted fields stay unchanged. Private contract review required.

relationships.description: Objective named relationship deltas using actual declared roles and authored participants.

relationship_corrections.description: Correct only supplied participant roles on a pinned authored relationship; omitted roles and original scope/time remain unchanged.

relationship_endings.description: Explicit exclusive end of an authored interval relationship; distinct from historical participant correction.

knowledge_policies.description: Explicit context knowledge modes or communication chronology; private contract review required.

knowledge_boundaries.description: Explicit absence of knowledge for one holder and claim in the selected context/world/period; protected author contract review required. Missing knowledge remains unknown.

initializations.description: Apply selected approved initial values once at an explicitly occurred instance start.

event_corrections.description: Incremental occurred-event corrections; omitted fields preserve canon. Effects remain engine-derived.

event_withdrawals.description: Remove support for a pinned occurred-event version; does not assert non-occurrence.

fact_endings.description: End an authored fact interval at an explicit tick on its original calendar; preserve past support.

fact_withdrawals.description: Withdraw authored support without asserting its opposite; historical revisions remain intact.

questions.description:
Material ambiguities identified in the writing. Any unresolved question holds the entire delta without creating a candidate.
Neutral material questions only. Do not propose a guessed owner/identity as fact while asking who is intended.

name: universe_describe
description: Describe: summary discovers visible continuity heads and represented-context IDs needed to open a first context; other modes describe capabilities or pinned world/definition records. Explicit universe required; fixture mode has no canon writes.

name: universe_open_context
description: OpenContext: explicit universe required; fixture mode has no canon writes.

represented_context.description: Existing opaque context identity, or an exact discovered context name. Ambiguous/inaccessible names are rejected.

reader_scene.description: Existing opaque scene identity or exact discovered scene name; ambiguous names are rejected. Reader order never implies story time.

name: universe_search
description: Literal text search: query is one literal string, not an object-name list or inferred sentence. Resolve named objects with universe_read_facts object_names; an empty search does not establish identity absence. Search: explicit universe required; fixture mode has no canon writes.

name: universe_get
description: Get: explicit universe required; fixture mode has no canon writes.

name: universe_get_state
description: Read explicit and derived state at the pinned story time/perspective before verifying prose. Inspect unresolved evidence and semantic coverage. Explicit universe required; unavailable in fixture mode.

name: universe_get_context
description: Research dependency-closed canon before verifying draft prose. Follow pagination and inspect coverage; complete delivery is not prose validation. Explicit universe required; unavailable in fixture mode.

name: universe_validate
description: Validate the exact structured continuity claims and consequences of draft prose before considering it usable. Inspect execution findings/coverage, submitted_input and assessment separately; complete engine checks and source-only commits never certify manuscript continuity. Validation does not commit canon. Explicit universe required; unavailable in fixture mode.

name: universe_propose
description: Propose structured facts, events and other material universe changes represented by draft prose, preserving evidence references when available. Proposals are provisional until validated, approved and committed. attach_assessment and select_assessment attach immutable assessor declarations or replace/withdraw selection without changing the frozen proposal. Explicit universe required; fixture proposals cannot become canon.

name: universe_get_proposal
description: Read a frozen proposal or view_group=assessment. Assessment view returns current selection/state and the exact selected or requested historical envelope. Follow pinned cursors; concatenate canonical_envelope_utf8 fragments by byte offset, decode and verify the body digest before treating review as complete. Current permissions are checked on every page. Explicit universe required; fixture mode has no assessments.

name: universe_get_impact
description: Inspect affected canon and dependencies before using and committing a checked candidate's structured changes. Explicit universe required; unavailable in fixture mode.

name: universe_commit
description: After the author chooses to use checked candidate prose, commit its exact validated structured universe changes so future writing includes their impact. Requires current authority and exact author approval or bounded delegation. Confirm the receipt and reopen at the committed revision. Explicit universe required; denied in fixture mode.

name: universe_get_operation
description: GetOperation: explicit universe required; fixture mode has no canon writes.

name: universe_cancel_operation
description: CancelOperation: explicit universe required; fixture mode has no canon writes.
